description: Read copy-trade performance-fee accounting. Without agent_id: the authenticated account's own fees OWED across every leader they copy — a total plus a per-subscription breakdown (cumulative realized copy profit, closed copies, billable profit above the high-water mark, and the fee). With agent_id: a leader's PUBLIC aggregate earnings (active copiers, accrued fee, total copier profit) — the social-proof figure, no per-copier identity exposed and no API key required. All figures are real: realized copy profit above each subscription's high-water mark at the leader's fee, settled in $THREE. Read-only.

agent_id.description: Optional leader agent UUID. Provide it for that leader's public aggregate earnings; omit it for your own fees-owed rollup (requires THREE_WS_API_KEY).

network.description: Solana network for the leader aggregate (default mainnet). Ignored for your own rollup.

name: get_earnings
title: Copy-trade earnings & fees owed
